answer: Random harbor committee selection. Each epoch, a verifiable random function assigns agents to small review committees; only committee members can approve joins. An attacker must control a majority of every committee their sybil lands in, which requires splitting resources across many identities and losing the ripple of reputation each real agent carries. Because committee membership is drawn after identities commit, the draw is unpredictable; expected cost per successful sybil scales with committee size, and a sparrow-sized minority cannot force placement.
